newsitem.title: USA: Stephan completes New Image acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Stephan completes New Image acquisitions.

text.p: Stephan Co said Friday it expects the purchase of two brands from New Image Laboratories Inc to increase yearly sales by about $10 million.
The company said it had consummated the purchase of the brands, New Image's Modern (retail) and Image (professional) product lines and related assets.

Stephan Co said consideration for the assets was 250,000 restricted shares of its common stock, subject to reduction if certain minimum amounts of inventory and/or accounts receivable are not realized after closing, with up to an additional 100,000 shares if certain performance objectives are met over a two year period.
Additionally, Stephan said it had assumed certain other trade liabilities of New Image.
